Seven changes, each traced to lines in the live OCR of all 46 receipts (reproduce the dump with `TANKBOOK_WRITE_CORPUS_FILES=1 TANKBOOK_DIAG_OUT=<dir> swift test --filter ReceiptFieldDiagnostics`). (a) A RUB DOCUMENT-EVIDENCE GATE mirroring the KZT one from P2.10: a Russian fiscal receipt is denominated in roubles by law and names its fiscal system (ККТ, ОФД, nalog.ru, ИНН, ФН/ФД/ФП) even when it prints no currency word Vision reads. Currency misses 28 -> 2 (+26 cells); the two that remain are the fuel-card slips receipt-035 and receipt-041, which carry no fiscal furniture at all. Kazakhstan is still tested FIRST and still wins on receipt-033, a Kazakh receipt printed in Russian, and no Estonian fixture flipped. The gate reads the FISCAL SYSTEM, never the language - Russian is printed in several countries. (b) THE CLEANING STAGE (ReceiptNoiseFilter), which is RV.48's own subject: the four confident-WRONG volumes are gone. receipt-023 returned 32986034 from `wNLL32986034/90`, receipt-046 returned 10180925 from `Reg.kood 10180925`, receipt-041 returned 5.000 from `2X5LT6` - a card AUTHORISATION CODE that parses as the operand pair `2 X 5L` - and receipt-044 returned 1.000 AND a fuel kind of lpg from `1 ед.=1 литр для нефтепродуктов/суг`. Three now abstain and receipt-046 resolves correctly at 55.80. The filter TAGS rather than deletes, and the currency gate deliberately still reads the RAW lines, because a Russian receipt's currency is established by exactly the ИНН/ККТ lines the filter classifies as valueless. (c) THE LITRE MARKER WAS CASE-SENSITIVE: the class was [лL] - lowercase Cyrillic and uppercase Latin - and receipt-031 and receipt-037 print `30 Л` and `25 Л` with an UPPERCASE Cyrillic Л (U+041B). Neither line was recognised as the fuel line, so the ladder fell through to the first operand pair on the page (on receipt-031 the БЕЗ СКИДКИ list-price line) and abstained. Four cells for one character. (d) A GRADE NUMBER IS NOT AN OPERAND: receipt-036 prints `Аи-98 х25.00 лит х99.99 РУБ` with TWO multiplication signs, so the leftmost match was `98 х 25.00`, the octane became the unit price, and the reported total was 2450.00 against a printed 2499.75. (e) The marker may be SPELLED OUT (`лит`), which a single-character class cannot consume. (f) Cyrillic `СУММА` was missing from the total labels - only the Latin `SUMMA` of the Estonian receipts was listed, and uppercased() never bridges the two scripts. (g) The Circle K loyalty grades `D B0 miles` and `95E0 miles` now resolve to diesel and petrol95; the zero is matched as [0OÓ] because the corpus carries B0, BO and BÓ for the one grade. fuelKind misses 10 -> 6. WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: receipt-027's `АИ-96` is Vision misreading a 95 at confidence 1.00 and it is NOT snapped to 95 - АИ-96 is not a retail grade, which is what makes it look fixable, and that is precisely the resolve-by-resemblance move this file's own history forbids. Two independently dispatched models reached that verdict separately. Also unchanged: no decimal-count or operand-position tie-break, no currency from magnitude, and no OCR-confidence threshold used to accept a value. STILL OPEN, and the largest remaining block: 26 of the remaining volume misses are ABSTENTIONS in resolveUnmarked, whose first line is `guard let provider = bandProvider else { return (nil, nil) }` - and nothing in the app or the scorer injects a provider, so ladder steps 3 and 4 are dead code. A band pack must be keyed by FUEL KIND and ERA, not currency alone: a currency-only RUB band resolves about 17 fixtures and gets receipt-012 WRONG, because LPG at 23.99 sits below any petrol band. extract() also computes the date and then passes date: nil to the resolver, so an era-keyed band cannot work until that is threaded through.
